# SparkCluster

Spark compute for the platform, a team or one person: size, runtime, settings; started by hand, stopped when idle.

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec.displayName` | string (nullable) | No |  |  | max 100 |
| `spec.driver` | object (nullable) | No |  | The pod shape of a driver or an executor. Absent fields follow the size class. |  |
| `spec.driver.cores` | integer (nullable) | No |  |  | min 1, max 16; format `int32` |
| `spec.driver.memory` | string (nullable) | No |  | For example `4Gi`. | pattern `^[1-9][0-9]*(Mi\|Gi)$` |
| `spec.env` | array of object | No |  |  | max 50 |
| `spec.env[].connectionRef` | object (nullable) | No |  | Where an environment variable's value comes from when it is not written in the spec. |  |
| `spec.env[].connectionRef.key` | string | Yes |  | The key inside that connection's synced Secret. | min 1, max 63; pattern `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` |
| `spec.env[].connectionRef.name` | string | Yes |  | Name of a `Connection` in the same namespace. | min 1, max 40; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `spec.env[].name` | string | Yes |  |  | min 1, max 64; pattern `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$` |
| `spec.env[].value` | string (nullable) | No |  |  | max 1024 |
| `spec.executor` | object (nullable) | No |  | The pod shape of a driver or an executor. Absent fields follow the size class. |  |
| `spec.executor.cores` | integer (nullable) | No |  |  | min 1, max 16; format `int32` |
| `spec.executor.memory` | string (nullable) | No |  | For example `4Gi`. | pattern `^[1-9][0-9]*(Mi\|Gi)$` |
| `spec.idleStopMinutes` | integer | No | `60` | Minutes without a job before the cluster stops by itself. `0` (never) is reserved for the shared cluster. | min 0, max 1440; format `int32` |
| `spec.image` | string (nullable) | No |  | A custom image, pinned by digest so a tag cannot move under the cluster. | max 512 |
| `spec.maxExecutors` | integer (nullable) | No |  |  | min 0, max 50; format `int32` |
| `spec.owner` | object | Yes |  | Who owns a `SparkCluster`: a group, or as an exception one person. |  |
| `spec.owner.group` | string (nullable) | No |  | The Keycloak group whose members start, stop and use the cluster. | min 1, max 64; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` |
| `spec.owner.user` | string (nullable) | No |  | One person's user name. The exception: prefer `group`. | min 1, max 128; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._@-]*$` |
| `spec.runtime` | string | Yes |  | The Spark and Python runtime, for example `spark-4.0-py3.12`. | pattern `^spark-[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-py3\.[0-9]+$` |
| `spec.size` | string | No | `small` | A Spark cluster's size class: three shapes an administrator picks instead of every number. | `small`, `medium`, `large` |
| `spec.sparkConf` | object (map of string) | No |  | Spark settings applied to the driver and the executors. | max 100 |
| `spec.state` | string | No | `Stopped` | The desired state of a `SparkCluster`. Start and Stop write it; the controller follows it. | `Stopped`, `Running` |

| `status.endpoint` | string (nullable) | No |  | The Spark Connect endpoint while the cluster runs. |  |
| `status.lastActivityAt` | string (nullable) | No |  |  |  |
| `status.message` | string (nullable) | No |  |  |  |
| `status.observedGeneration` | integer (nullable) | No |  |  | format `int64` |
| `status.phase` | string | No | `""` | `Stopped`, `Starting`, `Running`, `Stopping` or `Failed`. |  |
| `status.startedAt` | string (nullable) | No |  |  |  |

## Validation rules

- set exactly one of owner.group and owner.user
- pin the image by digest
- each env var name may appear once in env
- set exactly one of value and connectionRef
